product.olivetti-m300-28.summary: The 486SX M300 documented alongside the PCS44 and provisioned for i487SX or OverDrive.
product.olivetti-m300-28.history: The M300-28 brought the M300 range to the 486SX. Olivetti documented this model and the PCS44 in the same service chapter, with the BA362 board.
product.olivetti-m300-28.architecture: The board supported processor and RAM upgrades. The guide lists a 25 MHz i487SX or 25/50 MHz OverDrive, 4 MB soldered and 4, 8 or 16 MB SIMMs. Integrated video is OAK OTI-077.
product.olivetti-m300-28.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records V032004K.25.
product.olivetti-m300-28.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m300-28.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m300-28.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 35-1.
